status_note: FAA guidance document, no edition date seen
requirement_paraphrase: FAA waiver evaluators review the applicant's ConOps and hazard/risk analysis (severity, likelihood, mitigations, residual risk). For a 107.31 BVLOS waiver they check how the RPIC knows aircraft altitude/attitude/movement within C2-link limits, detects and avoids traffic, is alerted to degraded functionality, has the knowledge and skill, and which C2 links and FCC authorisations are used (BVLOS should not rely on FCC Part 5/15 devices).
